* Now in French, Portuguese, German, Italian, Dutch, Japanese, Chinese and Russian, with example trips from each language's own cities
* A ⚠ sign on bike stations with fewer than 3 bikes left
* A "·" divider between your trip and Transit's logo on the card
* Notification access shows clearly when it's on (green) or off (red)
* New translucent header in the settings
* Open the Source code page by swiping up from anywhere at the bottom, or with a quick flick
* Long text in the settings fades out at the edges instead of being cut off
* Fixed the Source code button sometimes not opening after a short pull
* This version is signed with a new permanent key: uninstall the previous version first, one last time
